ap_calculus_ab-f01.title: Decaying inflow and constant outflow: average inflow, meaning of F', amount at a time, time the amount returns to its initial value

stimulus.description: Rates of water flowing into and out of a reservoir

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Water flows into a reservoir at the rate $F(t)=80e^{-t/4}$ gallons per hour and flows out at the constant rate of $20$ gallons per hour, for $0\le t\le 24$, where $t$ is measured in hours. Find the average rate, in gallons per hour, at which water flows into the reservoir during the first $24$ hours.

rubric_rows.criterion: Integral of F over [0, 24] divided by 24
Answer

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find $F'(2)$. Using correct units, explain the meaning of $F'(2)$ in the context of the problem.
parts.model_answer: F'(2) = -12.131: at t = 2 hours the rate of inflow is decreasing by about 12.131 gallons per hour each hour.

rubric_rows.criterion: Value of F'(t) at the given time
Interpretation with units: the rate of inflow is changing (decreasing) at that time, in gallons per hour per hour
required_elements: the rate of inflow is decreasing

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: There are $200$ gallons of water in the reservoir at time $t=0$. Find the amount of water in the reservoir at time $t=24$.

rubric_rows.criterion: Initial amount plus the integral of the net rate
Answer

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: For $0<t\le 24$, there is exactly one time $t$ at which the amount of water in the reservoir is again equal to $200$ gallons. Write an equation involving an integral that this time satisfies, and find that time.
parts.model_answer: ∫₀^t (F(s) - 20) ds = 0 gives t = 15.683 hours (the amount rises while F > 20, then falls back to 200).

rubric_rows.criterion: Equation: the integral of the net rate from 0 to t equals 0
Solves the equation (calculator)
Answer with units: the time in hours
